question: I control two copies of Chronatog, and its ability can be activated only once each turn. Can I activate the ability once on each Chronatog in the same turn?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the once-per-turn limit applies to each Chronatog separately.
expected.answer: You can only activate the ability once each turn for each Chronatog.

whyHard: Players read the limit as a limit on the ability's wording for the whole turn, not on each object that has the ability.
